source.source_name: Colorado Business Entities (state registry, open data)
source.organization: Colorado Secretary of State / Colorado Information Marketplace (Socrata)
source.license: Open data (Socrata); verify Colorado open-data terms
source.data_freshness: regularly updated; 1M+ entities back to the 1800s
source.attribution: Attribution to Colorado Secretary of State / Colorado Information Marketplace recommended; verify terms before commercial redistribution.

access.credential_note: Socrata app token is OPTIONAL (recommended for higher rate limits at high volume), not required.

transport.download_url_note: A full CSV bulk export also exists; the JSON SODA API is preferred for incremental/paged ingest.
transport.record_path_note: SODA returns a top-level JSON array of entity objects.

pagination.note: Use $limit + $offset; optionally $order=entityid for stable paging and $where for incremental windows.

transport.rate_limit: Socrata SODA; throttled per-IP without app token

number_formats: entityid: keep as opaque string (leading digits encode year but treat as id)
field_name_caveats: jurisdictonofformation is MISSPELLED in the source (missing an 'i') — preserve the exact key.

keys.global_key_rule: Prefix with state code: 'CO:' + entityid (entityid unique only within Colorado).

mapping_rules.legal_name: Use entityname; strip appended delinquency annotations (e.g. ', Delinquent May 1, 2016') and keep the raw value in alternate_names as source_variant.
mapping_rules.legal_form: Map entitytype code (DLLC, FPC, ...) to a human legal form.
mapping_rules.incorporation_date: Use entityformdate (date portion) — most reliable incorporation date across US sources.
mapping_rules.registered_agent: Build a person-or-organization agent object from agentfirstname/middlename/lastname OR agentorganizationname + agentprincipal* address. Agent is NOT an owner.
mapping_rules.jurisdiction: jurisdictonofformation: 'CO' = domestic; other state code = foreign entity registered in CO.

fixture_requirements: Good Standing domestic LLC (DLLC) with principal address only
Delinquent record with mailing address and name carrying a status annotation
foreign entity (jurisdictonofformation != CO, entitytype FPC) with organization registered agent

live_test_plan.full: Page with $limit=1000 & $order=entityid behind explicit env gates; consider $where on entityformdate for incremental loads.
